q: Which node versions are in the test matrix?

results.text: The test matrix runs bun test across node 22 and node 24.
The gateway must never log full request bodies in production; pino structured logging with redacted fields is the convention.
Continuous integration runs in GitHub Actions on the self-hosted buildkite pool.
The canary-deploy feature was removed in v2.3; standard rolling deploys only.
Import statements are kept sorted alphabetically, enforced by the ESLint import/order rule.
The p99 latency budget for the gateway is 250 milliseconds.
The admin API is mounted under /_admin and requires the internal bearer token.
axios is forbidden in this codebase; outbound HTTP goes through the platform fetch wrapper with a 2-attempt retry budget.
The feature-flags service endpoint is http://flags.corp:7071 after the service mesh migration.
Staging runs Postgres 16 after the October migration; the old Postgres 14 cluster is decommissioned.
